paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search Using a Josephson Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
notes: ADMX sidecar cavity search using a JTWPA. Exclusion of axion-photon couplings above ~1e-13 GeV^-1 over 4796.7-4799.5 MHz (~19.835-19.847 ueV, centered at 19.84 ueV). Limit is roughly flat near 1e-13 GeV^-1; the exact curve shape (Fig. 7) varies but the abstract states 'above 10^-13 GeV^-1'. DM density 0.45 GeV/cc assumed.
